description: DONE (folded 2026-07-03, two-lane audited PASS/PASS). Hoisted the redundant per-arm executable binding out of transport_position_sort_key (jobs/transport.rs): let executable = position.executable() once, then the 7-arm match yields only (rank, first, second, index). Byte-identity proven per-variant by both the implementer and the correctness audit: the final 8-tuple (rank, executable.activation.function.as_u32(), input_structure_key, need.0, need.1, first, second, index) is character-for-character identical to parent; the secondary keys never referenced executable; position.executable() returns the same &ExecutableSymbol borrow type. Both matches exhaustive (no wildcard) so a future variant fails to compile in both places. Net -11 lines; sort-order-stability tests green. Now two call sites of TransportPosition::executable in jobs/transport.rs, matching the fz-go4.18.33 single-accessor pattern.
title: Delegate symbol extraction in transport_position_sort_key to TransportPosition::executable
